verdict.rationale: No dedicated export/dump endpoint or documented file format for memories is shown; however, the self-hosting option ("runs on your own hardware... single self-contained binary") and general API/SDK access for search/add suggest data isn't fully locked to the hosted SaaS. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk-export or data-dump API, a documented export format (e.g., JSON/CSV), and any independent confirmation that a full memory store can be extracted programmatically.
